oneSentenceStory: Daniel views his 7,300 coin balance and applies available cash-equivalent value directly as a statement credit to his linked card.
customerSituation: Daniel visits the mobile rewards overview to check his points balance and review cashback earnings.
storyTension: Ensuring transparent, friction-free translation of points into tangible bill relief without confusing voucher distractions.
customerResolution: Direct one-tap application of statement credits to his linked card balance.
primaryOutcome: Effortless tracking and redemption of cash-equivalent statement credits and financial goals.
